title: Battle of Issus
summary: Alexander the Great defeated a Persian army under King Darius III on a coastal plain in present-day southern Turkey. Darius fled and his family was captured. It was one of the decisive victories by which Alexander conquered the Achaemenian Empire.

as_recorded.value: The Battle of Issus, on 5 November 333 BCE

where.modern_name: Gulf of İskenderun coast, southern Turkey

importance.justification: A decisive victory in Alexander's conquest of the Achaemenid Empire, with Darius forced to flee.
